data.one_liner: The Stockfish Chess Engine for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Wraps the Stockfish chess engine C++ code for use in Flutter applications via Dart FFI. Enables sending UCI commands and listening to engine output streams.
use_when: You want to build a chess app in Flutter with an embedded chess engine.
You need to communicate with the Stockfish UCI interface on Android or iOS.
avoid_when: You need a package supporting platforms other than Android and iOS.
You are running multiple instances simultaneously, as only one instance is supported at a time.
strengths: Uses Dart FFI for performance when communicating with native C++ code.
Provides a simple ValueListenable for engine state and a Stream for stdout.
weaknesses: Only one instance can be created at a time.
